_comment: Combination-keyed per-model constraint registry (TD-AUTOCONFIG-COMBO-CONSTRAINTS).
SHIPPED DATA, not user config: loaded once at import by combo_constraints.py,
validated loudly, frozen. A row binds a COMBINATION of choices: it is consulted
only when every predicate in `when` matches the derivation's context, so a
derivation outside the combination never loads the constraint and nothing is
over-constrained.
Row fields:
id        - stable handle; tests and refusals quote it
kind      - engine_gate | validator. A combination row is an ENGINE-CURRENT
FACT (grep the cited site before trusting it), never `measured`
and never `heuristic` - re-measuring cannot change it, only an
engine commit can, and that commit DELETES the row.
when      - the combination, as predicate-key -> condition. A condition is a
bare scalar (equality), a list (membership), or an operator
object {gt|ge|lt|le|eq|ne|in: value}. Predicate keys are the
closed set combo_constraints.PREDICATE_KEYS; a GPU predicate
(e.g. gpu_class) is a NEW KEY there, not a new mechanism.
force     - dotted recipe path -> the only value the engine accepts under
the combination. A contradicting --pin REFUSES, quoting both;
never a silent override.
statement - present tense, what the engine DOES, boot-log voice.
ticket    - the TD whose resolution retires (deletes) this row.
site      - the engine code site that enforces the gate.
Deleting a row re-derives the config with the rule gone - no code edit
(the delete-the-row property tests in tests/unit/test_autoconfig_solver.py
keep this honest).

rows.statement: glm5_next rejects dcp_kv_mode=sharded at tp>=2: the 34 KDA layers' recurrent state is whole-sequence, so there is no token shard for a rank to own - the engine fail-closes with the fix in the message (GF3.10, mirror of TD-V4-DCP-KV; belt-and-braces refusal in the arch's validate_shape). Replicated KV is the only mode that boots.
